rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set, after the first holdout was consumed by its real-model run; never use it to tune prompts, retrieval, policies or scorer thresholds.
A run on this set is a gate. Any edit to holdout.json changes the hash and must be a deliberate, reviewed re-freeze with a new date and a note here.
Disjoint from development.json, evaluation.json and the consumed holdout.json (ids, domains, business questions).
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4).
supersedes: holdout (frozen 2026-10-26, consumed by the 2026-11-01 real-model run; its two misses were then addressed in the escalation rule and the decline scorer, so it no longer measures unseen cases).
